statement: No agreement between the two leading compute jurisdictions sets verifiable limits on training compute or capabilities (by 2028-06-30)
status_at_phase_end: No limits agreement as of 2026-11-14. Bilateral AI dialogue and incident channel agreed 2026-09-26; first technical round expected around APEC (2026-11-18/19). Neither side committed to capability or compute limits.

items.summary: Bloc A and Bloc B leaders held a summit in Bloc B's capital that covered trade issues including AI and agreed to build a 'constructive relationship of strategic stability'; no AI limits were discussed publicly, and chip-access issues were left aside.
items.detail: Trump visit to Bloc B, May 2026 (SIPRI essay; Xi remarks 2026-09-24 reference 'during your visit to Bloc B this year'). Exact summit date not verified - published date approximate.

items.summary: During a state visit, Bloc B's leader said both blocs, as leading AI nations, have the responsibility to ensure AI development 'is always under human control'; normative language, no concrete limits.
items.detail: Full text of Xi's arrival-ceremony remarks at the White House, 2026-09-24 (gov.cn / Xinhua).

items.summary: Official readouts: the two blocs agreed to establish a bilateral AI dialogue on risks and benefits (next round November 2026) and a bilateral communication channel for AI incidents. Creates a forum where limits could later be negotiated, but sets none.
items.detail: Bloc B MFA/Xinhua 'eight deliverables' item 7; White House fact sheet calls it the 'Bloc A-Bloc B Super Intelligence (SI) Dialogue' (Axios 2026-09-26).

items.summary: Bloc A's leader indicated limits on what would be shared with Bloc B and said Bloc A would not slow its AI efforts.
items.detail: AP report on summit outcomes (Trump remarks Saturday 2026-09-26).

items.summary: Bloc A's treasury head said the new dialogue would exchange best practices for pre-release model testing and alert each other to serious incidents, but made no commitment to limit advancement; Bloc B's foreign ministry had earlier (September) dismissed calls to slow frontier models.
items.detail: Bessent remarks to National Committee on Bloc A-Bloc B Relations, New York (Reuters/CNBC 2026-11-10/11); Bloc B MFA September statement per CNBC.

items.summary: Expert assessment: summit outcomes were incremental; terminology diverges between the blocs, the incident-channel design and reporting thresholds are undefined, and contentious compute-access issues were not addressed. Analysts expect no major breakthrough at the November round.
items.detail: SIPRI essay 'Building on progress in Bloc B-Bloc A talks on AI'; VOA expert interviews (CFR, Brookings, CSET). Publication date approximate (not verified).
